method_stage_contract.always_hard: the entire outer call is attributed to robust; feature/gate are zero by taxonomy, not absent internally
method_stage_contract.always_local: the entire outer call is attributed to local
method_stage_contract.counterfactual_cghik_v4: the entire outer call is attributed to robust; feature/gate are zero by taxonomy, not absent internally
method_stage_contract.hierarchical_cghik_v5: the runtime's cheap-feature, gate, local, and slow timings are mapped to the common stages
method_stage_contract.hierarchical_cghik_v5_lite: the runtime's Lite feature, gate, local, and fixed-HARD timings are mapped to the common stages

outer_timer: perf_counter_ns from method solve entry through materialized verified outcome; I/O and serialization excluded
primary_aggregation: median across five repeats per query, then cross-query quantile

stage_definitions.feature: first-level feature preparation attributed by hierarchical runtimes
stage_definitions.gate: first-level gate inference and threshold decision
stage_definitions.local: one-step previous-state local solver plus deterministic verification
stage_definitions.robust: complete invoked robust runtime, including its internal learned front end, solvers, and verification
stage_definitions.unattributed: outer API latency not included in the four explicitly attributed stages
